newsitem.title: UK: UK's SFO says not probing Morgan Grenfell or Young.
newsitem.headline: UK's SFO says not probing Morgan Grenfell or Young.

text.p: The UK's Serious Fraud Office said on Thursday it was not investigating Morgan Grenfell Asset Management or fund manager Peter Young.

Trading in three European funds run by MGAM was suspended on Monday and resumed earlier today amid an unofficial investigation by MGAM and British investments watchdog IMRO into suspected irregularities at the funds.

In response to a question whether the SFO was investigating Young, Morgan Grenfell Asset Management or Stewart Armer, a second MGAM fund manager suspended, SFO spokeswoman Ceinwen Jones said, "There is no investigation underway".
Jones said the SFO would become involved if a case were referred to them by individuals, organisations or companies.
The office generally acted if the case involved serious or complex fraud, sums of over one million stg, or had a foreign dimension, she said.
